title: Proposals
description: The candidate experiments of a session's diagnosis in the order worth running them.

stage.description: How much is known about this car: fewer than 5, 5 to 19, or 20 and more finished experiments.

skipped.description: Candidates measured on this car as negligible or worse.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A candidate experiment with what is expected of it and what it costs to find out.

basis.description: What the expectation rests on: this car's own measurement, a prior from another car, or nothing yet.

prior_source.description: Car the prior comes from; empty otherwise.

expected_gain.description: Expected improvement beyond the band of practical equivalence, per corner pass, in the channel's unit. Wide uncertainty raises it: an unknown knob is worth a look.

gain_low.description: Low end of the interval of the improvement; negative means it may make things worse.

laps_needed.description: Laps an A-B-A-B experiment needs to decide an effect of the expected size, out-laps included.

value_per_lap.description: Expected gain divided by laps needed: what the list is ordered by.

SkippedCandidate.title: SkippedCandidate
SkippedCandidate.description: A candidate that is not proposed, with the reason.
